skills.title: Le verbe to be
skills.lesson: I am, you are, he/she/it is, we are, you are, they are.
skills.example: I am a student. She is my sister.

skills.title: Le présent simple
skills.lesson: Avec he, she, it, on ajoute -s au verbe. Avec I, you, we, they, le verbe ne change pas.
skills.example: He plays football. They go to school.

skills.title: Le pluriel des noms
skills.lesson: En général on ajoute -s. Après s, x, ch, sh, on ajoute -es. Pluriels irréguliers : child → children, man → men.

skills.title: Les mots interrogatifs
skills.lesson: What = quoi/quel. Where = où. Who = qui. How old = quel âge. When = quand.
skills.example: How old are you ? I am twelve.

skills.title: Vocabulaire de l'école
skills.lesson: school = école, book = livre, teacher = professeur, pen = stylo, classroom = salle de classe.

skills.title: Listen and write
skills.lesson: Listen carefully and write the word. In English, the spelling is not always like the sound: check each letter.
